Hi Mom and Sunita,

- **Tracker:** The spreadsheet is at 81 applications. No interviews scheduled yet, but things are moving.
- **Wedding sheet:** Sunita, I'm adding rows to the vendor spreadsheet, so it's coming along. I'll flag you when the next batch is in.

Could we do a call next Tuesday or Wednesday after 5 p.m.? That way we can skip a second Sunday call this week and talk once things have moved a bit.

Love you both,
[your name]
